script:
local Oplayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local function GetF3x()
	for _, tool in pairs(Oplayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
			return tool
		end
	end
	if Oplayer.Character then
		for _, tool in pairs(Oplayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
			if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
				return tool
			end
		end
	end
end

local function InvokeF3X(actionName, ...)
	local F3x = GetF3x()


	return F3x.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint:InvokeServer(actionName, ...)
end

local function SpawnDecal(part, side)
	InvokeF3X("CreateTextures", {
		{
			Part = part,
			Face = side,
			TextureType = "Decal"
		}
	})
end

local function AddDecal(part, asset, side)
	InvokeF3X("SyncTexture", {
		{
			Part = part,
			Face = side,
			TextureType = "Decal",
			Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. asset
		}
	})
end

local ObamaID = 4681346638

for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	task.spawn(function()
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Back)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Bottom)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Front)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Left)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Top)

		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Back)
		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Bottom)
		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Front)
		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Left)
		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Top)
	end)
end
for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	task.spawn(function()
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Back)

		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Left)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		SpawnDecal(v, Enum.NormalId.Top)

		AddDecal(v, ObamaID, Enum.NormalId.Back)
